methods.name: Peer-Median

data.narrative:
Wayve is an AI & Software company at Series D stage, having raised $2.5B+ with a current post-money valuation of $8.6B. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, supplemented by reference to nine private and one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses a typical 1.5x multiplier for Series D progression, yielding $12.9B. Peer-median analysis across the six comparables produces a median valuation of $12.0B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $312.5B; the wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity within the AI & Software sector, particularly the outlier positions of Palantir at the high end and early-stage entrants like SandboxAQ at the lower bound.

Triangulating these methods yields a median valuation of $12.4B, with a defensible range of $10.2B to $14.8B. This range sits 19% above the current $8.6B post-money, consistent with stage-typical value creation between Series D and subsequent institutional rounds. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier given heterogeneous stage definitions across the peer set and the degree to which sector-wide AI valuations reflect sustainable cash generation versus market momentum. The peer range width itself signals valuation sensitivity to company-specific execution and market conditions.
